The '''Brema sector''', known as the '''Sullust sector''' during the era of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near the border of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], that included the planets [[Bortras]], [[Callos]], [[Cmaoli Di/Legends|Cmaoli Di]], [[Kerig'En]], [[Ord Ibanna]], [[Ord Simres]], [[Tuerto]], and the worlds of the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]]; [[Sullumun]], [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], and [[Lununmo]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Malcom]]. [[Pinacism]] swept through the sector despite the efforts of Malcom to halt it.<ref name="GNN12">{{JournalCite|12|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
